evidence: Created new product with all fields (name, category, price, rating, description, review, image, affiliate link, tags, spec, featured) via admin form; it immediately appeared correctly on /products, category page, homepage featured, and its own /product/{slug} detail page within the same session. Editing existing product (Sony) price/tags also reflected immediately on products list and detail page.

issue: Featured collection not browsable as complete set
actual: Marking/unmarking a product as featured does update the homepage's 3-item featured preview correctly. However the homepage "View all" link under Featured navigates to /products?featured=true, but the products page ignores the featured query param and shows all products (unfiltered count e.g. 10 products found instead of only featured ones), and there is no featured filter control elsewhere. With 4 products marked featured, visitors cannot browse the complete set of featured products.
evidence: home.featured showed only 3 of 4 featured products (capped); /products?featured=true returned "10 products found" with all products, not just featured ones.

Search "SONY" (uppercase) matched name case-insensitively (1 product found); search "exceptional" matched only description text (1 product found); search "qa-test" matched tag (1 product found). Result counts were accurate in each case.

issue: New tags not added to tag-filter choice list
actual: After adding tags "qa-test, smart, scale" to a product (and "addedtag"/"premium-renamed" to another), the advanced Tags filter list on /products still only shows the original ~35 seeded tags; none of the newly assigned tags appear as selectable filter chips, so they cannot be chosen as a tag-filter.
evidence: filters.tags collection listed 35 static tags with no "qa-test", "smart", "scale", "addedtag", or "premium-renamed" despite those tags existing on saved products and working in keyword search.
Created product with new tags "qa-test, smart, scale"; tags appeared correctly on the product detail page's tag list, and searching "qa-test" returned that product (1 product found).

Edited Sony's tags from "headphones, wireless, noise-cancelling, premium, editedtag" to "headphones, wireless, noise-cancelling, premium-renamed, addedtag" (removed editedtag, renamed premium, added addedtag). Detail page tag list showed exactly the new set; searching "addedtag" returned 1 product.
Edited Philips Hue Starter Kit category from Home to Fitness (single-select dropdown only allows one value); it then appeared under /category/fitness and was no longer listed under /category/home.
Selecting "Tech Gadgets" in the category filter on /products updated grid to 3 tech products and count to "3 products found".

Each product card in /products grid exposes name, category badge, price, description, image, rating (verified via textContent "...Tech$399Sony WH-1000XM5...4.8Buy Now"), and a Buy Now purchase action link.

Sort "Price: Low to High" ordered products $129.99→$2,495 correctly; "Top Rated" ordered 4.9→4.3 correctly; Minimum Rating filter "4.5+ stars" returned exactly the 8 products with rating>=4.5; Price range slider (min raised to $510) returned exactly the 7 products priced >=$510.

issue: No backend persistence; admin changes lost on reload
actual: After creating a new product and editing an existing product's price, a full page reload (navigating to the admin URL again) reverted the admin product list to the original 9 seed products with original values ($399 instead of edited $349.99); the newly created product disappeared entirely from admin, products list, and its detail page returned a not-found state.
evidence: Post-reload admin.products list showed only original 9 items with Sony back at $399; GET /product/mt9yjl2egya9ta6h6jv and /product/qa-test-smart-scale-2 style URLs returned not-found after reload.

Category field is a single-select dropdown (Tech Gadgets/Home Goods/Fitness), only one value can be chosen; changing Philips Hue's category to Fitness moved it out of Home category listing entirely, confirming exclusive single-category membership.

Combining tag filters "wireless" + "vacuum" returned exactly Sony (wireless) and Dyson (vacuum) — OR logic, each result has at least one selected tag. Combined with price-min $510 filter, all 7 results were >=$510. Rating filter 4.5+ returned exactly matching 8 products.

actual: Created a product with only Name and Short Description filled in (no image URL, no affiliate link, no full review, no specifications, price left at $0). The form accepted and saved it, and it immediately appeared live on the public /products page as "Incomplete Test Product" — violating the requirement that a product needs image, valid retailer link, full review, and at least one spec before being published.
evidence: admin.products list gained item "Incomplete Test Product" ($0) after submitting with only name+description; it then appeared in products.grid on /products.

/product/nonexistent-xyz-123 showed a not-found state with "Browse All Products" link and no product data. /category/bogus-category showed heading "Category Not Found" with message "The category you're looking for doesn't exist." and no unrelated product grid.

Every filter/sort/search change (category select, sort select, min-rating select, price slider, tag toggles, search text) updated the products grid and result count immediately without any manual reload throughout testing.

Each product card is a single <article> containing one <a href="/product/{slug}"> wrapping both the image and the name/heading; clicking the card (via its name) navigated to /product/macbook-pro-14 matching the clicked product.
Buy Now link on MacBook Pro detail page has href="https://example.com/macbook-pro", target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer" — opens the external retailer product page in a new tab.
Choosing "Tech Gadgets" in the category filter select updated filters.category active value to "Tech Gadgets" and updated products.grid to show only the 3 tech products.

Sony detail page textContent showed: category "Tech", rating "4.8", name, price "$399", description, Buy Now action, tags list, Key Specifications, and My Review — plus a product image (verified via querySelectorAll('main img') returning a valid image src).

Spot-checked Sony (tech: headphones/wireless/noise-cancelling/premium), Peloton (fitness: cardio/cycling/smart-equipment/subscription), Philips Hue (home: lighting/smart-home/ambiance/automation) — all tags/categories relevant to the product and identical between products list and detail page.

Sony price $399 and rating 4.8 identical across homepage featured, /category/tech, /products list, and /product/sony-wh-1000xm5 detail. Detail page review text rendered in full via DOM (no truncation), unlike the semantic hint's compact preview which truncates for display only.
